```{r setup, include=FALSE}
hispanicpop <-get_acs(geography= 'state', table= 'B03003', year=2023, survey='acs5')
orderhispanicpop <- hispanicpop %>% filter(variable == 'B03003_003') %>% select(NAME, estimate) %>% arrange(desc(estimate))

orderhispanicpop

#code ran to determine which states had largest hispanic population; this is all set up`
#Note: having year=2023 with survey=acs5 means data is being pulled from 2018-2023
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#starts working on pulling data here 
states <- c('CA', 'TX', 'NY')

#using pums data to do comparisons I want
pumsdat <- get_pums(variables = c('AGEP', 'HISP', 'SCHL', 'PINCP', 'ST', 'PWGTP', 'HINS1', 'HINS2', 'HINS3', 'SSIP'), state = states, survey = 'acs5', year = 2023)

#filtering Latino adults and education
latinos <- pumsdat %>% filter(HISP != 1, AGEP >= 25)
latedu <- latinos %>% mutate(college = ifelse(SCHL >= 21, 1, 0))
latedu <- latedu %>% mutate(PINCP= as.numeric(PINCP))


#pulls education attainment by state(% of college v. non college latinos)

stedu <- latedu %>% group_by(STATE, college) %>% summarise(pop = sum(PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% group_by(STATE) %>% mutate(percent = pop / sum(pop))

#pulls a median income by state and education
stin <- latedu %>% group_by(STATE, college) %>% summarise(median_income = weightedMedian(PINCP, w = PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


#using PUMS data I can do the comparisons I want so I rewrote what I did with this data instead of tidycensus 
#using weighted data as it's more accurate of the whole population; PUMS pulls a sample of the data which could bias my results 
#ST codes: 08-CA, 48-TX, 36-NY
#PINCP: personal income; SCHL >= 21 is bachelors or higher
```

```{r}
#doing more variables here for organization

#health insurance 
priv = ifelse(HINS1 == 1, 1, 0)
pub = ifelse(HINS2 == 1 | HINS3 == 1, 1, 0)
none = ifelse(HINS != 1 & (HINS2 != 1 & HINS3 != 1), 1, 0)

healthin <- latedu %>% group_by(STATE, college) %>% summarise(totalpop = sum(PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                                              priv = sum(PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE)/ totalpop,
                                                              pub = sum(PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE)/ totalpop, 
                                                              none = sum(PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE)/ totalpop, .groups = 'drop')

#SNAP/gov assistance
receiving = ifelse(SSIP == 1, 1, 0) 

snap <- latedu %>% group_by(STATE, college) %>% summarise(totalpop = sum(PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE), receiving = sum(PWGTP, na.rm = TRUE)/ totalpop, .groups = 'drop')
```
